bugs.error_message: Mobile TextElement.fromJson defaults/clamps diverged from web validateTextElement (single source of truth), so partial/legacy overlay records render wrong on mobile.
bugs.root_cause: fromJson defaulted width->0 (collapsed box), fontSize->0 (invisible), color->#FFFFFF (web uses #000000), and applied no clamping. Web storia/src/types/text-overlay.ts validateTextElement fills width->30, fontSize->4, color->#000000 and clamps x/y[0,100], width[1,100], fontSize[0.5,50], rotation[-180,180].
bugs.fix: Aligned fromJson to web validateTextElement: falsy(0/absent) width->30, fontSize->4; color default #000000; clamp x/y/width/fontSize/rotation to web ranges. Verified with scratchpad decode_check.dart asserts.

bugs.error_message: Reader overlay text (e.g. 'Suuuper soccer kick!') rendered rotated/displaced vs web book editor placement.
bugs.root_cause: Web editor (storia/src/components/IntegratedIllustration.tsx:299) rotates elements with transformOrigin 'left top'. Flutter Transform.rotate defaults to Alignment.center, so rotated text pivoted around its center instead of top-left, shifting it down/left and appearing over-rotated. fontSize(height)/shadow+padding(width) conventions already matched web.
bugs.fix: Set Transform.rotate(alignment: Alignment.topLeft) in OverlayTextElement so rotation origin matches web transformOrigin 'left top'.

bugs.error_message: Returning to the app shows the library screen with only the Flutter background (sky, clouds, sun, hills) but no game character, no book nodes, and no ground. Switching to another child profile makes everything load back up.
bugs.root_cause: The LibraryGame (FlameGame) lived in a process-wide singleton adapter (FlameLibraryMapEngineAdapter.instance) reused across LibraryScreen mounts. A FlameGame is single-attach: reusing the same instance on a freshly mounted GameWidget, or after the render surface was torn down on app background, re-attaches with an empty world. A cross-screen dispose race also let one screen's teardown dispose the game a newly mounted screen was rendering. The Flutter-drawn background kept painting in both cases, so only the Flame layer went blank. Switching child profile changed the book list signature, forcing loadBooks to build a fresh game, which masked the bug.
bugs.fix: Gave each LibraryScreen its own adapter via new FlameLibraryMapEngineAdapter.create() (kept static .instance for tests/back-compat); dispose() now only clears the singleton slot when identical(_instance, this), so a per-screen adapter never nukes the shared one. LibraryScreen now uses .create() and mixes in WidgetsBindingObserver: on AppLifecycleState.resumed it clears _loadedSignature and setState, so _ensureSessionLoaded rebuilds a fresh game and GameWidget.didUpdateWidget re-attaches it. Added widget regression test 'rebuilds the game view after the app returns from the background'.

bugs.error_message: AAC music demo MusicMode.off suppressed onSend sentence speech
bugs.root_cause: UtteranceSequencer.onSend returned immediately when config.mode was MusicMode.off, so disabling music also skipped the speakSentenceOnSend path. This violated the AAC invariant that speech is the communication layer and must not be suppressed by music settings.
bugs.fix: Moved the sentence-speaking block before the music-mode guard and only skipped _playProgression() when MusicMode.off. Added sequencer regression coverage that off mode speaks the built sentence while producing no music events.

bugs.error_message: After authentication, sign-in/sign-up screens hardcoded navigation to /library before the router redirected Supabase users without an active child profile to /profiles/select.
bugs.root_cause: Post-auth advancement was implemented twice: screen-side ref.listen blocks guessed /library while the router redirect owned the actual journey guard. The screen guess skipped the backend profile-selection gate, causing a visible double hop.
bugs.fix: Deleted the screen-side auth listeners and deepened the journey policy into JourneyPolicy.redirect. Added auth_auto_advance_regression_test to prove auth flips advance through the router backstop to /profiles/select or /library based on the snapshot.

bugs.error_message: Completing review onboarding hardcoded /library, letting authenticated users without an active child profile briefly navigate to library before the redirect corrected to /profiles/select.
bugs.root_cause: The review onboarding screen privately guessed the terminal route instead of asking the shared journey policy for the current user's next waypoint. The screen and redirect could disagree for dual-track states.
bugs.fix: Replaced the hardcoded /library success-forward navigation with continueJourney(ref, context), which reads the current JourneySnapshot and delegates destination selection to JourneyPolicy.nextLocation.

bugs.error_message: Narration audio continues playing for several seconds after navigating away from the reader screen back to the library
bugs.root_cause: ReaderEnd handler called _resetState() which only cancelled celebration timer and reset view state, but never stopped the AudioEngine narration/soundscape players. AudioEngine is an app-lifetime Riverpod Provider singleton, so the JustAudioPlayer kept playing after reader screen unmount. PageAudio interface had no stopAll() method.
bugs.fix: Added stopAll() to PageAudio interface and AudioEngine implementation (stops narration + soundscape, clears active flags and soundscape URL, increments request ID to cancel in-flight loads). Called await _pageAudio.stopAll() in the ReaderEnd handler before _resetState(). Added stopAll() to all 4 test FakePageAudio implementations.
